act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law for the limitation of suits and other proceedings and for purposes connected therewith.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Extinguishment of right to property
section.html: At the determination of the period hereby limited to any person for instituting a suit for possession of any property, his right to such property shall be extinguished.
section.text: At the determination of the period hereby limited to any person for instituting a suit for possession of any property, his right to such property shall be extinguished.
